content:
It's August, and the AirPods Pro 3 deals at $50 off, AirPods Max 2 at $100 off, and the all-time low on AirTag 2 are still rolling. But today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break headline is the M5 MacBook Air — we spotted the 24GB/512GB model down at $200 off, and we're also tracking up to $300 off certain configurations over at the official Apple Certified Refurbished store, including this 24GB 15-inch model (more here). Plus near $100 in savings across various Apple Watch Ultra 3 configurations, a brand new black Beats 240W braided USB-C cable for $18, and a chance to score the transparent red Beats Solo Buds for as low as $40. All the details below.

August AirPods deals up to $100 off: AirPods Pro 3, Max 2, and more from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (regularly $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (regularly $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (regularly $129)

Best Buy launches August Back to School sale: Apple gear, smart TVs from $80, dorm upgrades, more

Apple Refurbished Store now has the lowest prices we've seen on M5 MacBook Air, up to $300 off

Even though the retail prices of the latest MacBook lineup have gone up, and we've tracked plenty of deals up to $500 off, the official Apple Certified Refurbished store is now offering some of the best prices we've seen on select M5 MacBook Air configurations. We've recommended the lowest-priced base model from reputable sources, but you can now also get the 24GB 15-inch model for $300 under its new retail price, available in Midnight, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

The Apple Refurbished Store is now selling the 15-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 1TB of storage for $1,699 with free shipping. As mentioned above, this deal is available across all four colors: Midnight, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This MacBook Air has a new retail price of $1,900, and Amazon is currently selling all configurations for over $1,999.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (regularly $1,299) — $200 off
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,359 (regularly $1,599) — $240 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (regularly $1,999) — $300 off

Today's Apple Refurbished Store deal pulls this machine back to earlier pricing and is the biggest discount we've tracked since the price increase took effect. Given the current landscape, these new official prices are likely to stick around through the end of the year and even longer. So while it's not the lowest price ever, this is a very solid chance to save for anyone looking to jump into the M5 MacBook Air lineup this year — we likely won't see prices like this again until the next-generation MacBook Air launches in mid-2027 or later.

Browse all MacBook deals at the Apple Refurbished Store here — use the filters on the left side of the page to select the model you're looking for.

All-time low: 15-inch 24GB M5 MacBook Air now $200 off today

Still rolling: 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro down $500 at Amazon today

MacBook prices did just go up, but Amazon is still offering up to $500 off the 24GB/2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro this morning. Pricing is close to the best we've tracked before the price increase. More below.

Amazon is now selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB of storage for $2,499 with free shipping.

Given that this machine regularly goes for $2,999 at Apple and elsewhere, this is indeed a $500 discount. The deal is available on both the Space Black and Silver models.

This is the best deal we've tracked on the M5 Pro since the price hikes took effect at retailers.

Previously, Amazon's best discount on this machine was $300, but now it's an additional $200 off.

While this doesn't quite match the lowest price we tracked before the price increase, that's beyond our control — prices simply can't go back to the way they were. Considering the price hike that took effect about a month ago, this deal is just $100 off the all-time low price we've tracked for the M5 Pro.

Black and Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 models down nearly $100 at Amazon

Update: As expected, Amazon has now dropped prices on several other Ultra 3 configurations as well, including the Natural Titanium case with the Anchor Blue Ocean Band, down nearly $100. Details below.

While Series 11 deals have been steady, as we're seeing now in early August, Apple Watch Ultra 3 discounts have been more rare. However, this morning we spotted Amazon offering nearly $100 off the black Ultra 3 with the Black Unity Sport Band.

Amazon is now selling the black titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the Black Ocean Band for $699.99 with free shipping.

The regular price is $799, so this represents nearly $100 off and is the best new-unit deal we've found at a reputable retailer.

Aside from the brief $150 discount during Amazon Prime Day, this price matches the best of the year and is one of the few notable drops we've tracked at Amazon.

As of writing, the black with Ocean Band is the only configuration with a significant discount. But if this discount follows the pattern of the last one, we expect other color configurations to drop in price throughout the day and week.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Black Ocean Band $700 (regularly $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Anchor Blue Ocean Band $700 (regularly $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Blue Trail Loop $700 (regularly $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (regularly $899)

If you're looking to get the Series 11, you can score one for much less right now:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (regularly $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (regularly $429)

Brand new black Beats 240W braided USB-C cable drops to all-time low $18 with free shipping for Prime members (40% off)

Chance to score the transparent red Beats Solo Buds for as low as $41 today

The Solo Buds blew us away with the battery life of their built-in cell — they're currently the most affordable wireless earbuds in the Beats lineup. But at $80 MSRP and a regular $70 Amazon price, $41 with free shipping at Best Buy is even more appealing. Browse all Beats deals at Best Buy here, with more Solo Buds savings below.

Best Buy is now selling open-box transparent red Beats Solo Buds in 'excellent' condition for $40.99 with free shipping. That's roughly half the MSRP and well below Amazon's $70 new-unit price.

  • Fully functional and looks like new.
  • All parts and accessories included. Packaging may differ and may not be included.

Sure, you could call what you're picking up an entry-level set of earbuds, but we're talking about a contemporary pair of earbuds from Apple's Beats brand for $41.

As mentioned above, our testing showed that this set delivers up to 18 hours of listening time on a single charge with the built-in battery. While it's not a wireless charging case design, for most users, $41 with this kind of battery life is more than enough. Other features include one-touch seamless pairing, a custom microphone with an 'advanced noise learning algorithm' for superior call quality, and industry-leading Class 1 Bluetooth.
